stories.title: Tennessee Intersquad TODAY — 5 PM ET, Free

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
TODAY is the day.

Tennessee softball's final public intersquad: 5 PM ET at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium.

FREE admission. Watch Pickens, Mardjetko, and Shelton pitch before winter.

After tonight, this team goes dark until spring. #VolSoftball

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Karlyn Pickens. 194 K. 1.70 ERA.
Kelly Mardjetko. 16-3. 1.26 ERA.
Bailee Shelton. 7 K in 3 fall innings — as a freshman.

All three pitch tonight at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium, 5 PM ET. FREE.

Last public look at the SEC's deepest staff. #VolSoftball

article.headline: Tennessee Softball's Final Public Intersquad Is Tonight — Free at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium

stories.title: OU Fall Finale Preview — Tomorrow Night at Love's Field

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
TOMORROW: Oklahoma softball's fall finale.

Love's Field. Oct. 30. 6:30 PM CT. Free on 1oklahoma.com.

Last chance to see Kendall Wells (39 HR) and Rylie Kavan (2x WCWS MOP) before spring.

One of the top-3 national title contenders is worth watching. #Sooners

stories.title: Early Signing Period Looms — What the NCAA Eligibility Rule Means for November

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The early signing period opens in November — but the NCAA's new 5-for-5 rule is changing everything.

Commits are backing out. Programs are recalculating roster math. A federal lawsuit is already filed.

This signing period will not look like any before it. #SoftballRecruiting
